instruction: A candid documentary photograph captures a medium shot of a bright modern office. In the center, the man in the black blazer (R1) stands behind a cluttered desk, looking up with an intense expression as he throws papers. To his left, the woman in the beige vest (R3) faces right, throwing white sheets into the air with her arms raised. To his right, the woman in the brown plaid blazer (R2) faces left, raising her hands high in celebration. The three colleagues are joyfully throwing papers and high-fiving. The background features shelves with green plants under warm indoor lighting.
elements: R1 stands behind the cluttered desk and throws papers
R3 throws white sheets into the air with her arms raised
R2 raises her hands high in celebration
the colleagues are joyfully throwing papers and high-fiving
white sheets and papers are airborne
the scene is a bright modern office

questions.element: R1 has the desk-side paper-throwing role

questions.element: R3 has the white-sheet throwing role

questions.q: Is R2 the person raising her hands high in celebration while R3 throws white sheets, rather than R3 only raising hands in celebration while R2 throws the sheets?
questions.element: R2 has the raised-hands celebration role
